introduction-section.description: I build software with a focus on maintainability, system design, and user experience.

about-page.title: About Me
about-page.subtitle: I'm passionate about developing tools that solve real-world issues and make a positive impact on people's lives. I believe software truly fulfills its purpose when it’s both intuitive and useful.

falcon-seguros.title: Falcon Seguros: Travel Insurance
falcon-seguros.description: A commercial travel insurance platform in production. Developed with React, TypeScript, and Node.js, focusing on performance, advanced SEO, and lead conversion strategies.

online-chat.title: Online Chat Study
online-chat.description: A real-time chat application using Node.js and Socket.io. Implements bidirectional communication and client-server architecture for instant messaging with a responsive interface.

image-classifier.title: Dog and Cat Image Classifier
image-classifier.description: Development of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with TensorFlow and Keras. Achieved 86% accuracy in automated image classification through Deep Learning.

medical-analysis.title: Medical Data Analysis
medical-analysis.description: Statistical analysis and data visualization of medical records using Pandas and Seaborn. Processing large datasets to identify correlations between lifestyle and heart disease.

web3-token.title: Web3 Standard Token
web3-token.description: Creation and deployment of an ERC20 Smart Contract (RICO Coin) in Solidity. Implements supply logic, transfers, and governance on Ethereum-compatible networks.

barcode-api.title: Barcode Generator API
barcode-api.description: Scalable Flask API for barcode generation. Robust architecture with unit testing (Pytest), data validation with Cerberus, and strict linting with Pylint.

apple-study.title: Apple Products Interface Study
apple-study.description: High-fidelity interactive interface simulating the Apple Watch configurator. Focuses on DOM manipulation, UI states, and fluid animations in pure JavaScript.

spotify-study.title: Spotify Interface Study
spotify-study.description: Interface clone focused on pixel-perfect design and UX. Implements search and dynamic navigation functionalities, integrating modern frontend concepts and APIs.

river-inf.title: River-INF: Engine Study
river-inf.description: A classic vertical shooter developed in C with Raylib for UFRGS. Implements binary data persistence, modular logic, and game state management.

colbiz.description: Full-Stack development (Web, Mobile, Backend, and Cloud) across the entire software development lifecycle. Responsible for designing new applications, evolving legacy systems, integrating services, and resolving critical production incidents (C#, .NET, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, AWS).

fadema.description: Automation of the software internationalization process within the IF Mais Empreendedor program. Development of a cloud-based solution (Python, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, and gspread) for UI mapping and automated translation integrated with Google Sheets, bypassing local infrastructure limitations.

ufrgs.institution: UFRGS - Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul
